recognize_zh: 一大團嗜中性球（加上一個單核球）被密密麻麻的血小板黏附覆蓋，形成白血球–血小板聚集團，背景游離血小板很少，符合血小板衛星現象合併聚集。
features: Large aggregate of about a dozen segmented neutrophils and one monocyte-like cell
Innumerable platelets adherent to and interspersed among the leukocytes
Leukocyte nuclei show normal segmentation; cytoplasm without toxic change
Few free platelets elsewhere in the field
Red cells normochromic, arranged loosely in the background
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a large leukocyte-platelet aggregate composed of numerous segmented neutrophils and a monocyte-like cell, extensively coated by adherent platelets. A smaller satellitism cluster is present to the right. Free platelets in the background are scant, and red cells are unremarkable. Findings are consistent with platelet satellitism with leukocyte-platelet aggregation, which can produce spurious thrombocytopenia and occasionally spurious leukopenia on automated counts.

ddx.vs: Clumps consist of platelets alone rather than platelets rosetting around leukocytes, though both are anticoagulant-induced artifacts.
Leukoagglutination forms neutrophil clumps without the dense coating of platelets seen here.

ddx.dx: Thick smear edge or feathered-edge accumulation
ddx.vs: Cells pushed to the feathered edge are not bound together by platelets and are accompanied by distorted, crowded red cells.
